description.en: A grout option sized for common residential tile joints. Its stated joint range and application make it easier to compare colors, flexibility and cleaning needs before installation. This listing is for flexible terracotta cement grout for tile joints, for residential kitchens and wet areas.

Este anúncio apresenta rejunte cimentício flexível terracota para juntas, para cozinhas e áreas molhadas residenciais.
